name: Hosur
about: Just across the state border on the Hosur Road industrial belt.

name: Nandi Hills
about: The closest hill escape to Bengaluru — sunrise views and the Bhoga Nandeeshwara temple at the foot.

name: Kolar
about: East of Bengaluru, with the Kolaramma temple and Antaragange caves.

name: Tumakuru
about: A short run up NH 48, home of the Siddaganga Matha.

name: Lepakshi
about: The Veerabhadra temple with its hanging pillar and the giant Nandi.

name: Shravanabelagola
about: The monolithic Gommateshwara (Bahubali) statue on Vindhyagiri hill.

name: Mysuru
about: The palace city: Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills and Brindavan Gardens, with Srirangapatna on the way.

name: Puttaparthi
about: Prasanthi Nilayam, the ashram of Sri Sathya Sai Baba.

name: Yercaud
about: A small hill station in the Shevaroy Hills above Salem.

name: Vellore
about: Vellore Fort, CMC hospital and the Golden Temple at Sripuram.

name: Hassan
about: Base for the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu.

name: Salem
about: On the way to Yercaud and the south of Tamil Nadu.

name: Kabini
about: Riverside lodges on the edge of Nagarhole National Park, known for jungle safaris.

name: Anantapur
about: On NH 44 north of Bengaluru, towards Hyderabad.

name: Chitradurga
about: The stone fort of Chitradurga, on the way north to Hampi.

name: Bandipur
about: Bandipur National Park on the Mysuru–Ooty road, a tiger reserve with forest safaris.

name: Sakleshpur
about: A quiet Western Ghats hill town of coffee and spice estates, with Manjarabad Fort close by.

name: Belur
about: The Chennakeshava temple, a masterpiece of Hoysala carving, with Halebidu nearby.

name: Chikkamagaluru
about: Coffee country with Mullayanagiri, Karnataka’s highest peak, and Baba Budangiri nearby.

name: Tiruvannamalai
about: The Annamalaiyar temple and Arunachala hill.

name: Coorg
about: Coffee estates and misty hills around Madikeri — Abbey Falls, Raja’s Seat and the Golden Temple at Bylakuppe en route.

name: Tirupati
about: Gateway to the Sri Venkateswara temple at Tirumala.

name: Wayanad
about: Green hills and plantations — Edakkal Caves, Banasura Sagar dam and Chembra Peak.

name: Davanagere
about: Central Karnataka city on the NH 48 corridor.

name: Kanchipuram
about: The city of a thousand temples and silk sarees.

name: Srikalahasti
about: The Srikalahasteeswara temple, often combined with Tirupati.

name: Kukke Subramanya
about: The Kukke Subramanya temple in the Western Ghats, often paired with Dharmasthala.

name: Ooty
about: The Nilgiris hill station — tea gardens, the lake, Doddabetta and the toy train.

name: Shivamogga
about: Gateway to the Malnad region, Jog Falls and the Sakrebyle elephant camp.

name: Dharmasthala
about: The Sri Manjunatha Swamy temple on the Netravati river.

name: Tiruchirappalli
about: Rockfort and Srirangam, one of the largest temple complexes in India.

name: Mahabalipuram
about: The Shore Temple and Pallava rock carvings, a UNESCO site on the coast.

name: Chennai
about: The Tamil Nadu capital, straight down the Bengaluru–Chennai highway.

name: Coimbatore
about: Tamil Nadu’s industrial city, close to Isha Yoga Center and the Nilgiris.

name: Puducherry
about: French Quarter streets, the promenade and Auroville.

name: Sringeri
about: The Sringeri Sharada Peetham on the banks of the Tunga.

name: Hampi
about: The ruins of the Vijayanagara capital, a UNESCO World Heritage Site on the Tungabhadra.

name: Horanadu
about: The Annapoorneshwari temple deep in the Malnad hills.

name: Kozhikode
about: Calicut’s beach, food and history on the Malabar coast.

name: Mangaluru
about: The coastal city of Karnataka — beaches, temples and the route down the Shiradi Ghat.

name: Thanjavur
about: The Brihadeeswarar temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Guruvayur
about: The Guruvayur Sri Krishna temple near Thrissur.

name: Udupi
about: Home of the Sri Krishna Matha, with Malpe beach a short drive away.

name: Palakkad
about: Kerala’s gateway through the Palakkad Gap, with the Palakkad Fort.

name: Murudeshwar
about: Seaside temple town with one of the tallest Shiva statues in the world.

name: Hubballi
about: North Karnataka’s commercial hub, twin city of Dharwad.

name: Kodaikanal
about: The “princess of hill stations” — the lake, Coaker’s Walk and pine forests.

name: Jog Falls
about: One of India’s highest plunge waterfalls, on the Sharavathi river.

name: Madurai
about: The temple city of the Meenakshi Amman temple.

name: Munnar
about: Kerala’s best-known tea hills, with Eravikulam National Park.

name: Badami
about: Rock-cut cave temples, with Aihole and Pattadakal close by.

name: Gokarna
about: Temple town and quiet beaches — Om Beach, Kudle and Half Moon.

name: Thekkady
about: Periyar Tiger Reserve and spice plantations.

name: Kochi
about: Fort Kochi, Chinese fishing nets and the gateway to the backwaters.

name: Rameswaram
about: The Ramanathaswamy temple and the Pamban bridge.

name: Alleppey
about: Houseboats on the Kerala backwaters.

name: Kanyakumari
about: India’s southern tip — the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and sunrise over three seas.
